scope: Post-freeze authored-case semantics/length audit, no new candidate or model evaluation.

frame_protocol.scope: official ON generation prefix plus explicit OFF-template empty-thought boundary; only public answer tokens scored, closing-turn tokens excluded; no thought read, generated, or scored; not free-thinking ON generation

ll_limitation: Finite replay persists correct NLL only per fold; single-case LL contribution cannot be reconstructed.
concentration_limitation: Case-delta sums are descriptive, not the 76-constraint objective, semantic accuracy or WSP scores.
